prompt: Write the Flisk service.json files for a "shop" stack: a bring-your-own Postgres called "shop-db" (image postgres:16, port 5432, no health path), a migrator called "shop-migrate" that depends on "shop-db", an HTTP API backend called "shop-api" on port 4100 that depends on "shop-migrate", and a frontend called "shop-web" that depends on "shop-api". Reply with a JSON array of the four objects and nothing else.

Write the Flisk service.json files for a "kitchen" stack: a local model server called "brain" (bring-your-own, image ollama/ollama, port 11434, health check /v1/models), an MCP server called "menu-tools" on port 4200, and an AI agent called "chef" that depends on "brain" and "menu-tools". Reply with a JSON array of the three objects and nothing else.

Write the Flisk service.json files for a "mail" stack: an HTTP API backend called "mail-api" on port 4300, a worker called "mail-sender" that depends on "mail-api", and a one-shot bring-your-own job called "mail-seed" (image acme/seed:1) that must not restart and depends on "mail-api". Reply with a JSON array of the three objects and nothing else.
